findings.title: only the driver folds hook guidance; PROTOCOL.md's on_verify_fail step still hands multi-line `.artifact.guidance` straight to `task set`, which now refuses
the refusal's remedy tells the caller to hand-edit `.orchid/tasks/<id>.md`, which PROTOCOL.md forbids the orchestrator and the README says is never needed
`task list` still renders a damaged task file as a row of empty fields, the exact signal fm_check's own header names as how both dogfood operators were misled
